nodes.name: Microwave-assisted BPN synthesis
nodes.procedure: The multi-layer BP nano-sheets were synthesized by a microwave-assisted method with slight modification [33]. At first, 0.25g of finely ground red phosphorous is mixed with ethylenediamine (37.5mL) in a beaker and stirred for 20min. Next, the beaker was irradiated in a microwave-oven for 45min at 70°C. The product was rinsed with ethanol for three times and dried with a vacuum dryer at 40°C. Subsequently, 50mg of the dried product is added to 10mL of N-methyl pyrrolidone. The dispersion is irradiated in a microwave oven for 50min at 120°C. The supernatant was centrifuged at 5000rpm for 20min and filtered through a Whatman filter paper. The final product of multi-layered black phosphorous nanosheets was obtained after drying in an oven at 45°C for 1h.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal Fe-Mg-MOF synthesis
nodes.procedure: 0.04 mmol FeCl3.6H2O (0.010 g), and 0.04 mmol MgCl2.6H2O (0.008 g) were dispersed in a 25 mL beaker containing 8.5 mL of DI water (Beaker 1). In another beaker, an organic linker terephthalic acid (0.14 mmol, 0.023 g) was mixed with 14 mL of DMF (beaker 2). Next, the bimetallic dispersion in beaker 1 was slowly added into beaker 2 and stirred for 35min. Then, 20mL of aliquot was autoclaved at 120°C for 7h using Teflon-lined stainless steel. The powdered product was thoroughly rinsed with ethanol to eliminate the unwanted particles. The final product is dried in the oven for 24h at 50°C and stored in the refrigerator before further use.

nodes.name: Fe-Mg-MOF-BPN/GCE sensor fabrication
nodes.procedure: The GCE surface was polished smoothly on a microcloth pad with 0.03μm alumina slurry. After this, it was sonicated in ethanol and acetone, and dried with N2 gas. To prepare Fe-Mg-MOF-BPN/GCE sensor, Fe-Mg-MOF and BPN powder mass (2:2) were mixed in a water-ethanol mixture (3:2) solution and stirred for 20 min at room temperature. Finally, 6μL of Fe-Mg-MOF-BPN homogeneous solution is drop-casted onto the GCE surface and dried before the experiment.
